style.backgroundSystem: alternating deep charcoal photographic scene panels #2B2B2D and clean white infographic panels #FFFFFF with light grey #F5F5F5 section fill; dark sections may use a near-black #1E1E20 depth layer
style.iconSystem: solid vermilion #D5281F circular icons with thin white line glyphs; thin red leader-line callouts with small labels
style.lightingSystem: low-key directional soft light with controlled brushed-metal specular highlights on dark scene panels; flat even high-key light on infographic panels; always a soft contact shadow under the product
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent hardware-ecommerce infographic visual system across the entire set; fixed palette of pure white info panels #FFFFFF, deep charcoal scene panels #2B2B2D, light grey section fill #F5F5F5, and one vermilion red accent #D5281F for capsule labels, round icons and callouts; neutral temperature; bold modern sans-serif headlines with rounded capsule label chips; alternating dark photographic scene sections and clean white infographic sections; solid red circular icons with thin white line glyphs; product rendered as brushed stainless steel with controlled specular highlights and a soft contact shadow; stable product scale, every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins, thin red leader-line callouts; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
noDrift: no added brand marks, QR codes or membership badges
style.presentationRules: stable eye-level or low-angle product views; brushed steel keeps controlled specular highlights; capsule label and white card label styles stay identical across the set; every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins
style.surfaceSystem: matte charcoal walls, wood-grain furniture tops and wooden floor planks for scenes; pure white or light grey graphic panels for info screens
style.typography: bold modern sans-serif only; red capsule label chips, large charcoal headlines on white panels and white headlines on dark panels; short two-line labels under icons
